name: search
algorithm: Look up splitmix64 keys in a sorted slice of 2^20 distinct u64 (2i+1) with each language's std binary search; a found key adds its index plus 1 and a miss adds 1, wrapping (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; a search has no arithmetic to wrap

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries, each with its own search loop; the keys are distinct, so every correct search gives the one checksum
notes: Binary searches (B20's naming): mk Slice.Search (lower bound, comparator a const fn argument); c bsearch, exact match only, an indirect comparator through a function pointer (labelled); rust binary_search; zig std.sort.lowerBound; go slices.BinarySearch; cs MemoryExtensions.BinarySearch.
